text: RA treatment of NB4 (and KG1) cells rapidly and directly induces transcription via functional RA-response elements in target promoters — e.g. IEX-1 induced within 30–60 min by atRA/cis-RA through two promoter RAREs — which is consistent with promoter activation, though the retrieved evidence documents only a single immediate-early gene (IEX-1) in NB4/KG1 rather than genome-wide active-promoter marks in "DIF2" cells.
